title: Meerkly fetch job parameters
description: Canonical definition of the wait/capture parameters shared by POST /v1/html (snake_case), the gateway->worker fetch frame (camelCase), and both worker implementations. Source of truth for names, bounds, and defaults; the conformance vectors in vectors/ bind all implementations to it.

waitFor.description: When to capture the HTML. One of the reserved keywords, or any other non-reserved string which is treated as a CSS selector (wait until visible, then stable-settle). Empty/omitted resolves to 'stable'. Selectors are validated server-side (cascadia); invalid -> 400.

waitForKeyword.description: Reserved wait_for keywords. 'stable' = DOM structurally quiet ~500ms (content mutations only; CSS animations ignored), capped by settle_ms. 'networkidle' on Android is the window load event (headless-GeckoView limit).

settleMs.description: Cap on the stable-settle wait. 0/omitted = worker default. Effective worker value: min(settleMs > 0 ? settleMs : 5000, 25000) — see constants.

detectMs.description: How long the worker probes the wait_rules guards. 0/omitted = worker default. Effective worker value: min(detectMs > 0 ? detectMs : 200, 25000) — see constants.

waitRule.description: Conditional wait: if the guard selector ('if') becomes visible within detect_ms, the target ('then': a wait keyword or CSS selector) is waited for as a required wait. First matching rule by list order wins; no match -> the top-level wait_for fallback.

if.description: Guard CSS selector. Must be non-empty and compile; invalid -> 400.

then.description: Wait keyword or CSS selector. Empty resolves to 'stable'.

waitRules.description: Prioritized rule list, probed in order.

constants.description: Shared numeric semantics every worker MUST implement identically. Enforced by the conformance vectors.
